utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Leo — I’m glad the repair drive is coming together. Quinn has the details, so it’s probably best to check with them; I’m just keeping things quiet on my end right now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Uli. I’ll check with Quinn and keep it simple: safety issues first, then the rest.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Leo — that sounds right. I appreciate you keeping it simple and thoughtful.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Kira, I can confirm folks should start bringing things by around 10, but I’m not going to say Opal is organizing until I’ve checked that part.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo—that helps on the 10 o’clock drop-off, but before I pass it along, can you confirm who I should name as organizing it, if not Opal?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: For now, don’t name Opal yet—just say the repair drive team is taking drop-offs around 10, and I’ll confirm the organizer before you pass along a name.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Rosa, I’m happy to help with the repair drive, but I’m still confirming the table setup and exact details with Opal before I repeat anything as official.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Sam—that’s perfect. Just make sure Opal has the latest: it’s Sunday at the community center, and we’re putting broken locks, active leaks, and no heat at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Got it, Rosa—I’ll make sure Opal has Sunday at the community center and that broken locks, active leaks, and no heat are the top priorities. I won’t pass it around more widely until I’ve checked in with her.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m putting the list together now, Hana, but I’m only writing down confirmed names and tools. By early evening I’ll have the repairs, supplies, and Sam’s arrival time sorted as cleanly as I can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Eli — please keep Mara’s Saturday 10 to noon note marked as tentative unless she confirms it, and separate Sam’s arrival time from the repairs until you hear directly.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do, Hana — Mara’s Saturday 10 to noon stays tentative, and I’ll keep Sam’s arrival in its own line until I hear it directly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Opal, let’s keep Saturday 10 to noon firm for the repair drive, with Faye on check-in or sorting. Once Sam confirms the tables and east entrance supplies, we can place his group.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Agreed, Mara—Saturday 10 to noon stays firm, Faye stays flexible for check-in or sorting, and I won’t place Sam’s group until he confirms the tables and east entrance supplies.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Opal — I’ll keep the schedule anchored there and note Sam’s group as pending until his update comes in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Oren—quick check, have you heard anything solid on the repair drive, especially whether Opal or Mara is actually organizing it? I promised I wouldn’t pass along guesses.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m glad you asked, Bo—solid bit I have is Rosa’s list sets safety first: broken locks, active leaks, and no heat, with drop-off around 10. I don’t know for sure whether Opal or Mara is organizing, so I won’t name either until I check.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, that helps—I’ll only pass along Rosa’s safety-priority list and the 10-ish drop-off, and I’ll leave Opal or Mara out until someone confirms.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late as usual, Ira, but I’ve got the confirmed list started: Mara’s crew is sorting tools, and I’m leaving times or extra-hand slots blank until Sam’s report comes in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane—can you mark whether anyone’s confirmed drills, ladders, or extension cords yet? I’m passing Mina updates while I’m out, and I’ll also keep telling folks Saturday 10 to noon is the key window with Faye helping.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I don’t have any confirmed drills, ladders, or extension cords yet, Ira, so I’ll leave those blank. I’ll also keep Saturday 10 to noon and Faye’s help in the pending notes until Sam’s report confirms the timing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Vik, I need firm repair drive details by tonight—what are you bringing, and do you know exactly when Sam’s group is arriving?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mina, I’m telling folks Saturday 10 to noon is the key window with Faye helping then, but I don’t have Sam’s group’s exact arrival yet. I’m still waiting on Oren’s tool-list note before I say what’s missing or what I’m bringing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, but I need commitments, not maybes—can you confirm your own tools by 6, and ask Oren or Sam directly for the arrival time?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m glad folks are ready to help, Jules, but we still need Rosa’s full list with addresses, callback numbers, and exact repair issues before we send anyone out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, Pia — I won’t send anyone out or share firm times until Rosa’s full list is in and Sam’s report lines up with it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Jules — once those match up, we can sort the urgent locks, leaks, and no-heat calls first and make sure Gus’s tools go where they’re actually needed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Tess, I’m still working from second-hand updates on the repair drive—have you heard anything confirmed about when Sam’s group is joining Mara’s crew this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Nell — I haven’t got anything confirmed yet, so I’m checking with Quinn before I repeat a start time. I’ll let you know once it’s solid, and I’m also asking around about tools.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Tess—I’ll hold off on passing along any start time too. If you hear anything solid from Quinn, especially about timing or tools, I’d appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Faye, I only know the drive is Sunday at the community center, with broken locks, active leaks, and no heat first. I’m asking quietly in my building today, so if you hear anyone urgent, I can help pass that along.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks Rey — I had heard Mara was aiming for Saturday 10 to noon, so I’ll check with her before I pass along Sunday details. If I hear of any urgent locks, leaks, or heat issues around school pickup, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye—I’ll hold off repeating the Sunday time until Mara confirms, and I’ll only pass along urgent repair names if we hear them directly.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Gus, thanks—I’m still waiting on Rosa’s list before we set the day or send anyone out, but it sounds like locks, leaks, and no heat are the main things, so keep those tools handy.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Noah—I’ll keep the lock kit, plumbing tools, and heater basics ready, and once Rosa’s list lands just tell me where to bring the workbench.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—once Rosa sends the addresses and callback numbers, I’ll give you the day and where to set up the bench.
